prem_4230cecf5f623084.text: The faster weight loss observed with daily dark chocolate consumption has been reproduced in more than one independent human study population.

prem_5279089774b2028e.text: Cocoa flavanols present in dark chocolate increase resting energy expenditure or reduce intestinal fat absorption in humans.

prem_7813c4d03376fff6.text: Participants assigned to dark chocolate in that trial did not consume fewer total daily calories or expend more exercise energy than the comparison group.

prem_d7557db19613fb7f.text: In that trial, the group consuming dark chocolate daily reduced body weight over a shorter period than the group following the same diet without chocolate.

prem_f833eed9baf65e43.text: The between-group difference in rate of weight loss in that chocolate trial met conventional thresholds for statistical significance and was not attributable to chance in a small sample.

prem_fbd038c1d1b30eb4.text: To accelerate weight loss means to increase the amount of body weight lost per unit of time relative to a comparison condition.

prem_fcadb6e1e5a3dfc9.text: A randomized controlled trial assigned overweight adults to a reduced-carbohydrate diet plus a daily fixed dose of dark chocolate or to the same diet without chocolate.

root_claim.source_text: Health section of a national newspaper.
root_claim.text: Eating dark chocolate accelerates weight loss.
